title: What If You Got 1% Smarter Every Time Someone Called You Stupid?

lines.t: Leo, you're so stupid.
lines.el: [mocking] Leo, you're so stupid.

lines.t: And suddenly... you understand calculus.
lines.el: And suddenly... you understand calculus.

lines.t: Because starting today, every time someone calls you stupid, you get one percent smarter.
lines.el: [curious] Because starting today, every time someone calls you stupid, you get one percent smarter.

lines.t: And people call you stupid... a lot.
lines.el: [ominous] And people call you stupid... a lot.

lines.t: Here's the rule. Every time anyone calls you stupid, dumb, or an idiot, your I Q goes up one percent. And every time someone calls you smart... it drops one percent.
lines.el: Here's the rule. Every time anyone calls you stupid, dumb, or an idiot, your I Q goes up one percent. And every time someone calls you smart... it drops one percent.

lines.t: Your I Q right now is a hundred. Perfectly average. You got a C minus in math. Twice.
lines.el: Your I Q right now is a hundred. Perfectly average. You got a C minus in math. Twice.

lines.t: But one percent stacks. Thirty four insults, and you're officially a genius. Seventy, and your I Q is two hundred.
lines.el: But one percent stacks. Thirty four insults, and you're officially a genius. Seventy, and your I Q is two hundred.

lines.t: Two hundred thirty one insults... and you'd have an I Q of one thousand. No human in history has ever come close.
lines.el: Two hundred thirty one insults... and you'd have an I Q of one thousand. No human in history has ever come close.

lines.t: Day one. Kyle calls you stupid in the hallway. Plus one percent.
lines.el: Day one. Kyle calls you stupid in the hallway. Plus one percent.

lines.t: Your sister calls you stupid at breakfast. She does that every morning. Plus one percent.
lines.el: Your sister calls you stupid at breakfast. She does that every morning. Plus one percent.

lines.t: By lunch, you've read every book in the school library. By dinner, you speak French. And Japanese. And a little bit of Latin.
lines.el: By lunch, you've read every book in the school library. By dinner, you speak French. And Japanese. And a little bit of Latin.

lines.t: So you get smart. Really smart. You start doing stupid things... on purpose.
lines.el: [smug] So you get smart. Really smart. You start doing stupid things... on purpose.

lines.t: You wear socks with sandals. You walk into a glass door. Twice. You put pineapple on pizza... in front of the whole cafeteria.
lines.el: You wear socks with sandals. You walk into a glass door. Twice. You put pineapple on pizza... in front of the whole cafeteria.

lines.t: Dude, you're SO dumb!
lines.el: [laughing] Dude, you're SO dumb!

lines.t: Plus one. Plus one. Plus one. By Friday, your I Q is two hundred. You finish your math test in four minutes. Your teacher cries.
lines.el: Plus one. Plus one. Plus one. By Friday, your I Q is two hundred. You finish your math test in four minutes. Your teacher cries.

lines.t: Then someone posts a video. The kid who gets smarter when you call him stupid.
lines.el: Then someone posts a video. The kid who gets smarter when you call him stupid.

lines.t: And the whole internet joins in. Millions of comments. Stupid. Idiot. Brainless. Dumbest kid alive. Every single one makes you smarter.
lines.el: [building] And the whole internet joins in. Millions of comments. Stupid. Idiot. Brainless. Dumbest kid alive. Every single one makes you smarter.

lines.t: Plus one percent. Plus one percent. Faster than you can scroll.
lines.el: Plus one percent. Plus one percent. Faster than you can scroll.

lines.t: By morning, your I Q is one thousand. You can see math in everything. In raindrops. In the way your cereal floats.
lines.el: By morning, your I Q is one thousand. You can see math in everything. In raindrops. In the way your cereal floats.

lines.t: Scientists fly in from around the world. You solve a problem they've been stuck on for thirty years. On a napkin. In nine minutes.
lines.el: [awed] Scientists fly in from around the world. You solve a problem they've been stuck on for thirty years. On a napkin. In nine minutes.

lines.t: Your face is on every news channel. The smartest person who has ever lived. And he's fifteen.
lines.el: Your face is on every news channel. The smartest person who has ever lived. And he's fifteen.

lines.t: But there's a problem nobody warned you about.
lines.el: [tense] But there's a problem nobody warned you about.

lines.t: When your mind runs a thousand times faster, the world starts to feel... slow. Conversations feel like waiting for a song to load. Jokes feel like puzzles you solved hours ago.
lines.el: When your mind runs a thousand times faster, the world starts to feel... slow. Conversations feel like waiting for a song to load. Jokes feel like puzzles you solved hours ago.

lines.t: You stop laughing with your friends. You start correcting them.
lines.el: You stop laughing with your friends. You start correcting them.

lines.t: And one night at dinner, your dad tries to read a letter out loud. He struggles with the long words. He always has. And you sigh. Loudly.
lines.el: [cold] And one night at dinner, your dad tries to read a letter out loud. He struggles with the long words. He always has. And you sigh. Loudly.

lines.t: Sorry, Leo. I'm... I'm not as smart as you.
lines.el: [hurt, quiet] Sorry, Leo. I'm... I'm not as smart as you.

lines.t: Plus one percent. Because even your dad just called himself stupid... and somehow that counts.
lines.el: [quietly] Plus one percent. Because even your dad just called himself stupid... and somehow that counts.

lines.t: Your brain is buzzing. You can't sleep. You can't stop thinking. And for the first time, you feel completely alone.
lines.el: Your brain is buzzing. You can't sleep. You can't stop thinking. And for the first time, you feel completely alone.

lines.t: There's only one way back. People have to tell you that you're smart. Each time... minus one percent.
lines.el: There's only one way back. People have to tell you that you're smart. Each time... minus one percent.

lines.t: But nobody does. Why would they? You're a genius. Saying it out loud feels pointless.
lines.el: But nobody does. Why would they? You're a genius. Saying it out loud feels pointless.

lines.t: And then your sister sits next to you on the stairs.
lines.el: [softly] And then your sister sits next to you on the stairs.

lines.t: You're smart, Leo. You were always smart. Even when you got a C minus.
lines.el: [gently] You're smart, Leo. You were always smart. Even when you got a C minus.

lines.t: Minus one percent.
lines.el: Minus one percent.

lines.t: You were smart when you taught me to ride a bike. You were smart when you knew I was sad before I said anything.
lines.el: [smiling, tearful] You were smart when you taught me to ride a bike. You were smart when you knew I was sad before I said anything.

lines.t: Minus one. Minus one. The buzzing gets quieter.
lines.el: Minus one. Minus one. The buzzing gets quieter.

lines.t: You're the smartest kid I know. You always were. Not because of a number.
lines.el: [warm] You're the smartest kid I know. You always were. Not because of a number.

lines.t: Your dad says it every night. Your mom says it at breakfast. Your friends say it at lunch.
lines.el: [emotional] Your dad says it every night. Your mom says it at breakfast. Your friends say it at lunch.

lines.t: Nine hundred. Five hundred. Two hundred. A hundred and forty.
lines.el: Nine hundred. Five hundred. Two hundred. A hundred and forty.

lines.t: Three weeks later, your I Q is back to a hundred. Perfectly average.
lines.el: Three weeks later, your I Q is back to a hundred. Perfectly average.

lines.t: And you understand something no I Q test can measure. Being smart was never about being faster than everyone else.
lines.el: And you understand something no I Q test can measure. Being smart was never about being faster than everyone else.

lines.t: It was about understanding the people next to you.
lines.el: [softly] It was about understanding the people next to you.

lines.t: Also, you're stupid.
lines.el: [teasing] Also, you're stupid.

lines.t: Plus one percent.
lines.el: [pause] Plus one percent.

lines.t: Who in your life makes you feel smart? Tag them in the comments.
lines.el: Who in your life makes you feel smart? Tag them in the comments.
